_lore: Canon: the rarest core; the greatest range of magic, though slow to reveal it; the most initiative; the pickiest, its allegiance hard won. Gameplay: bonds slowly and resists being won, then recovers faster from every spell once loyal.
_making_canon: Affinity +1 = a pairing a famous wand carried: holly: Harry Potter (PS ch.5); yew: Voldemort (PS ch.5)
